_about: The demo product at phone size (390 x 844, touch on), for the style previews whose moves want a phone-size take (relayout-phone-take and relayout-phone-take-framed). The same flow as the walkthrough, by touch: tracked cards, the button, the list and the field (product animations), a tap that opens the drawer after a short wait, a menu, a drag, a toggle, the toast, a swipe, typing and a second page from the tab bar. A phone has no hover and no shortcut keys. The first tap comes after a 1.6 s rest: the drawer fills a phone screen, so the dashboard must be seen (and marked) before it opens.
